title: E Komo Mai
description: Observations from within another meaning of love.
body: Come, let me hold you for a while,/arms overhead to cover us from the splintering glass/of a/blood orange sky;/e komo mai, there is more than mercy/breaking in me/for you,/more than/sorrow in bloom.

The blood of the covenant/is thicker than the water/of the womb/and thicker still than/the cicatrix/woven over the wound I cannot heal/simply by knowing it exists,/but there is no/calling more humbling than keeper,/no duty more immersed in reverence than remembering;
you can find me in child's pose/Supplicant to the grief that protrudes from our chests/committing it to memory
Come,/let us hold you/for a while.
